title: Fix chat message deduplication race between API and WebSocket
description:
**Bug**: `dashboard/src/hooks/useRunChat.ts:21-63` — When a user sends a chat message, both the API response and the WebSocket broadcast can add the same message to the store. The chat store (`chat.ts`) has dedup logic, but there's a race window where both arrive before dedup is checked.

**Fix**: Use message ID as the dedup key. In `addMessage` in `chat.ts`, check if a message with the same ID already exists before appending. Alternatively, use a Map keyed by message ID instead of an array.

**Files**: `dashboard/src/hooks/useRunChat.ts`, `dashboard/src/state/chat.ts`
definitionOfDone: No duplicate messages appear when API response and WebSocket event arrive concurrently
Chat store deduplicates by message ID
